title: UGANDA FILM FESTIVAL 2026 POSTPONED
text:
PUBLIC
NOTICE
UGANDA FILM FESTIVAL 2026 POSTPONED
The Uganda Communications Commission (UCC) wishes to inform filmmakers,
partners, audiences, and the general public that the 2026 Uganda Film Festival
(UFF) has been postponed following guidance issued by the National Taskforce
on Ebola Response and the Ministry of Health.
The postponement affects all festival activities, including film screenings and the
Uganda Film Festival Awards Gala that had been scheduled for Friday, June 5,
2026.

sponsors, exhibitors, and festival audiences, the health and safety of the public
remains our highest priority.
